body: Crystal grids are a powerful way to strengthen your intentions, but it can be confusing to know how to set one up for your specific goal. We’ve taken the guesswork out of using crystal grids by providing 10 of the most powerful crystal grid templates for 10 of the most popular intentions, such as love, health, prosperity, sleep, and more. Whether you have years of experience using crystals or you are just starting out, these crystal grid layouts will help you get started with crystal grids and crystal combinations. By providing you with the set-up instructions, plus an explanation of how and why your crystal grid will support your intention, this PDF guide will help you every step of the way. The best part about these templates is that you can use and reuse them anytime you want to set a new intention. Simply come back to this guide and pick whichever template best suits your goal. PLEASE NOTE: This is a digital product (PDF download). The purchase of all digital products is non-refundable and all sales are final.
